name: branch-do-file-invalid-exception
description: branch's matching case names a do file that exists but fails to parse, reporting the parse failure as an "Exception: " detail
yaml:
appId: com.test
name: branch invalid do file
proxy: optional
---
- launchApp
- capture: "POST /login as: loginRsp"
- branch:
    from: loginRsp
    on:
      - match:
          status: 200
        do: "{{DIR}}/invalid-branch-do.yml"
